evidence_slice: Wandsworth Borough Council's adopted Local Plan page confirms that the Wandsworth Local Plan 2023-2038 was adopted on 19 July 2023 and remains in force except for six housing policies superseded by the March 2026 Partial Review. The adopted plan identifies CJ4, Land at Clapham Junction Station, SW11, as a 3.07 hectare site allocation. It allocates the site for safeguarding of the station, including surface works associated with Crossrail 2, and mixed-use development including residential, commercial and other appropriate town-centre uses, with comprehensive redevelopment in association with the station and other site allocations. The public Planning Local Plan Data service for Wandsworth exposes Site Specific Allocations as polygon layer 26 in British National Grid EPSG:27700.
